description: Single-select glass list of categories filtered by the selected budget type. Re-skins the bespoke selectBox. Falls back to a dashed empty affordance when no categories exist for the type.

categories.type: Array<{ id: string; name: string; type: string }>

type.description: Filters the list: categories.filter(c => c.type.toLowerCase() === type)

value.description: Selected category id (may be empty — category is optional)

onCreate.description: Routes to category creation; used by the empty affordance

behavior: Single-select. If filtered list is empty, render the dashed empty affordance instead of an empty box; '+ Create' calls onCreate. Category stays optional — empty selection does not block Save.

accessibility.label: {category name}
accessibility.colorIndependent: Selection conveyed by checkmark icon + checked state, not the purple tint alone
